verdict.rationale: AMD explicitly states the ROCm software stack that powers the MI355X 'is open source, cross-platform... and optimized for AMD Instinct devices,' which lets an AI-native user access source for the software layer, but there's no explicit license name, no repo links, and the hardware/silicon design itself is obviously not open-sourced.  missing for 10: named open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache), direct links to source repositories, clarity on which components (drivers, firmware, hardware) are excluded from openness, independent confirmation of source availability.
